title: DoorDash, Sunnyvale Finalize Next Steps on Autonomous Delivery
summary: Dot Makes First Appearance at State of the City
body_markdown:
**SUNNYVALE, CA** – DoorDash and the city of Sunnyvale have agreed on a proposal to introduce Dot, the company’s autonomous delivery robot, to the Sunnyvale community. Through a measured set of steps that promote public safety and community engagement, this exciting partnership will pave the way for these all-electric, compact devices to reliably bring orders straight to a customer’s door while safely navigating city streets.


> “We’re so excited to add Sunnyvale to our partner cities as we work to bring autonomous delivery to the Bay Area. This agreement is an important step to start the process of getting Dot onto the road in Sunnyvale, and we look forward to continuing conversations with our partners to ensure that we are able to do it safely, productively, and in lock-step with the community.”
>
>
> **-** **Ashu Rege, VP and Head of Autonomy at DoorDash Labs** .


> "As a small business, our biggest challenge is always reach — serving our signature dishes to more families across Sunnyvale. We value our partnership with DoorDash and are excited to expand our fast, reliable delivery thanks to Dot."
>
>
> **–Zoe Chijate, Operations Manager & Catering Director, Hobee’s, local Sunnyvale restaurant**


DoorDash will be participating in Sunnyvale’s Annual Tech Expo on October 15 where the community can see Dot in action. In October 2024, DoorDash attended the Tech Expo to introduce DoorDash’s autonomy work to the Sunnyvale community, and attended again in 2025 following months of collaboration with City staff. Today’s announcement marks another key milestone in DoorDash’s collaboration with the City to bring Dot to the streets of Sunnyvale.


Dot will be on the streets to begin mapping in the coming weeks.


### **DoorDash Labs**


****[DoorDash Labs](https://labs.doordash.com/) was founded with the goal of making systems and processes more efficient and effective for Dashers, merchants, and consumers. Designed by the team at DoorDash Labs,[Dot](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/dot) is engineered for safe, reliable trips through your neighborhood with zero emissions for quieter, greener neighborhoods.
